title: Continuity of the Integrated Density of States
exact_target: Show that the integrated density of states has no jumps as the energy varies.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 7900014 (AMR-078-0014). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
Barry Simon, Schrödinger operators in the twenty-first century, Mathematical Physics 2000, pp. 283–288, original Problem 14.
Wikipedia contributors, Simon problems, pinned revision 1335881350, The 2000 list. Existing catalogue wording adapted; CC BY-SA 4.0.

status_qualification: The original higher-dimensional continuum scope is restored; the bare catalogue sentence omitted it. The operator class and regularity hypotheses of the referenced integrated-density-of-states framework require specification, rather than an assertion for every arbitrary spectral model.
